title: The degree-one recurrence for opposite source-Hom mates
statement: In the setting of [def-sf-native-hom-source-shift-data], additionally assume tensoring is additive in both variables. Fix M in D and write H(X)=ihom(X.unop,M) on the triangulated opposite D^op. Write b_n(X) for the raw siteHomOppositeSourceShift(X.unop,n) evaluated at M. For every integer m and X in D^op, b_(m+1)(X)=(-1)^m times H(shiftFunctorAdd_op(m,1).hom_X) followed by b_1(X[m]), the shift by 1 of b_m(X), and shiftFunctorAdd(m,1).inv_(H(X)). Only the second parameter 1 is asserted; this statement contains neither the zero law nor arbitrary two-parameter addition nor the quadratic-sign correction.

source.place: Tags 08J9 and 08JC, tensor-Hom adjunction and lemma-RHom-triangulated; explicit native mate calculation, agent expansion.

proof.text: For the left tensor mate a(K,r)=c(K,r) followed by t(K,r) inverse, prove the addition identity for r+s=t. Expand the parameter comparison by CommShift.commShiftIso_add' and cancel the parameter compositor and its inverse. Apply curriedTensor.commShift₂_comm once with parameter r and argument s, giving the unit scalar (r*s).negOnePow. Expand the argument comparison in the order s,r. The inverse shiftComm is the inverse s,r compositor followed by the r,s compositor, so the latter cancels. Thus the composite left tensor maps differ from a(K,t) by exactly that scalar.

Use the explicit shift adjunction shift(r) left adjoint to shift(a), with r+a=0. The right-adjoint mate of the shift-addition hom s+r=t is the shift-addition inverse a+b=c: prove this by applying the inverse hom equivalence and the Mathlib shiftFunctorCompIsoId_add'_hom_app identity for the counits. Identify siteHomSourceShift with conjugateEquiv of the left tensor mate. Express precomposition, whiskering and the associator as mates, using conjugateEquiv_whiskerLeft, conjugateEquiv_whiskerRight and conjugateEquiv_associator_hom. Repeated conjugateEquiv_comp transfers the tensor addition identity. The right adjoint is additive, so the scalar is preserved. All helpers are fully proved.

Transport the inverse shift parameter using sourceMate_transport, so siteHomOppositeSourceShift(K,n) is the mate for the explicit shift adjunction (-n,n). The opposite shift-addition hom unops to the original inverse compositor with parameters -m and -1, by shiftFunctorAdd'_op_hom_app. Specialize the proved mate addition identity to (-m,-1,-(m+1)) and inverse parameters (m,1,m+1). Its sign is m.negOnePow; multiplying once more by this unit, whose square is one, gives the displayed successor identity for every integer m, without any division or positivity assumptions.

from.place: Proof, second paragraph: internal Hom is triangulated in the first variable and the exact comparison pullback carries triangles to triangles, so the comparison maps form morphisms of triangles. This node supplies the native signed shifts used in that clause.

theorem siteHom_opposite_source_shift_successor (M : D) (m : ℤ) (X : Dᵒᵖ) :
    (siteHomOppositeSourceShift X.unop (m + 1)).hom.app M =
      m.negOnePow •
        ((MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj M).map
            ((shiftFunctorAdd Dᵒᵖ m 1).hom.app X) ≫
          (siteHomOppositeSourceShift (X⟦m⟧).unop 1).hom.app M ≫
          ((siteHomOppositeSourceShift X.unop m).hom.app M)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫
          (shiftFunctorAdd D m 1).inv.app ((ihom X.unop).obj M))
